=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
The `get_resource_ratios` method in `tardis/adapters/batchsystems/htcondor.py` raises a `ValueError` when one of the resource ratios is `undefined` or even has the value `error`. This can happen when the `pslot` is in the process of being formed and variables like `Cpus` or `Memory` are not yet defined.

The current implementation tries to convert all values to floats without checking if they are valid. This leads to crashes that can be worked around with an `ifThenElse`, but catching an `error` string in TARDIS and retrying later would be more reliable.
